title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v113 (adaptive batching + telemetry)
author: Amina Patel
release_notes: Adds v113 profiling baselines for adaptive-batching workloads and a reporting pipeline that uploads summarized metrics to the benchmark dashboard. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: the benchmark lab needs updated profiling baselines to evaluate adaptive batching heuristics across representative workloads (chat, completion, embeddings). This PR introduces v113 of profiling baselines, a new reporting pipeline that aggregates per-run metrics (latency P50/P95/P99, token throughput, memory high-water mark, KV cache hit ratios), and telemetry hooks required for automated comparisons.

What this PR does: - Adds workload runner configs for adaptive-batching experiments (small/medium/large seq lengths). - Introduces baseline artifacts (v113) stored under benchmark-lab/baselines/v113/ with metadata for model, hardware, and config hashes. - Implements a reporting pipeline (benchmark-lab/pipelines/report-v113.yaml) that validates run outputs, computes summary stats, and pushes results to the internal benchmark dashboard. - Adds telemetry instrumentation (metrics and tags) to the runner to capture KV cache hits, batch sizes, and retry events. - Adds CI job that runs a smoke profiling run in the benchmark sandbox and verifies expected metrics.

Testing and validation: ran the full pipeline in staging (see CI run in checks). Collected runs for 3 representative models and validated that the computed summaries match offline scripts. Added unit tests for summary calculators and end-to-end smoke test in the pipeline.

Rollout and migration: this is additive. Baselines are versioned (v113); dashboards will read v113 once the pipeline finishes. No runtime default changes. If any regression is observed we can revert to previous baseline via dashboard config.

Related: ENG-3456 (adaptive batching evaluation), ENG-4821 (benchmark reporting enhancements), SUP-987 (support request to measure cold-starts).

Checklist:
- [x] Add baseline artifacts and manifest
- [x] Implement reporting pipeline YAML
- [x] Add telemetry tags and metrics
- [x] Add CI smoke test
- [x] Update dashboard ingestion docs

Notes: kept changed files minimal and added documentation in benchmark-lab/README-profiling.md to describe v113 artifact layout and how to re-run the pipeline locally.
